outlets.name: Okinawa Traveler (沖縄トラベラー, by the editors of local magazine Rikka Docca)
outlets.credible: Okinawa-based editorial travel/food site whose features are written by the staff of the local magazine リッカドッカ; area-by-area soba, steak and shokudō features; one editorial source

outlets.name: Good Luck Trip (gltjp.com)
outlets.credible: Japanese inbound-travel publisher with editor-written articles and shop profiles; one corroborating source (directory pages treated as weaker; never paired with another GLTJP page)

outlets.name: macaroni (macaro-ni.jp)
outlets.credible: Major Japanese food media (editor-written features, tens of millions of monthly readers); one source

outlets.name: GIGAZINE
outlets.credible: Long-running Japanese web news outlet with staff-written on-site food reports; one source

outlets.name: Okinawa Prefecture — 「琉球料理が味わえる店」 certification
outlets.credible: Prefectural certification (since FY2023) of restaurants with ≥5 yrs operation, ≥5 Ryukyu dishes and ≥50% local ingredients; official program — counts as ONE source, not a lone authority
